statement: Every affine hyperbolic number-field curve of proper genus at least two with potentially good curve reduction at the coefficient prime p has only cuspidal arithmetically normalized procyclic pro-p subgroups, without a special p-rank restriction. Consequently every degree-d cover of the punctured Gaussian elliptic curve satisfies the normalizer criterion at every coefficient prime p>d.

notes: Root and DE independently audited the complete proof, reopened Raynaud and Crew primary statements, and reran the exact certificate: PASS. Registered after both audits. Proper normalization of any geometrically connected cyclic p-power cover over a good special rank-one curve has connected, geometrically unibranch and hence irreducible special fibre. Its inertia quotient is globally etale, the unique main normalization is radicial over that quotient, and unramified Deuring–Shafarevich gives main p-rank one. Raynaud makes all exceptional ranks zero and the graph a tree. Hence every such Prym has p-rank zero; an actual perpendicular character and the integral invariant-transfer lattice exclude a normalized generator of any homology valuation. Includes p=2. Potential good CURVE, not merely Jacobian, remains essential. No full fixed-group result or universal all-prime claim.
